blind.description: A square, plump presentation cushion upholstered in deep crimson velvet, trimmed with gold accents and adorned with golden tassels at all four corners. Resting centrally on top is a small, carved bone fragment or golden relic. The model is cleanly defined, solid, and stylized with smooth surfaces and no floating or malformed elements.
blind.from_above: A square burgundy pad with four golden corner tassels, featuring a small pale bone fragment resting near the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Under 1/15th of the figure's height (around 3 to 4 inches tall) and about 8 inches wide.
